snapshot.name: FCC AM Engineering Data Base
snapshot.policy: Display source values as stored. No correction or reconciliation against current LMS.
snapshot.facilityIdPolicy: The 1997 AMDATA.DAT does not populate the six-character ID-number field used by the 2008 snapshot. H97-xxxxx facility keys are deterministic grouping IDs based on country, callsign, frequency, city, and state; they are not FCC Facility IDs.
